title: Newark HOME-assisted unit maximum rent limits
requirement: Rents for HOME-assisted units may not exceed the maximum HOME rent limits (the lesser of the area fair market rent or 30% of the adjusted income of a family at 65% of area median income), and the owner must give tenants at least 30 days' written notice before any rent increase.
key_value: lesser of FMR or 30% of adjusted income of a family at 65% of area median income
coverage_conditions: Units assisted with HOME Program funds (HOME-assisted units) in the City of Newark.

conditions.text: only HOME-assisted units receiving HOME Program funds are covered

coverage_quotes: The DHA must review and approve rents proposed by the owner for units subject to the maximum rent limitations

exemptions: Rents for a project need not be lower than the HOME rent limits in effect at the time of project commitment.
quoted_span: (i) The fair market rent for existing housing for comparable units in the area as established by HUD under 24 CFR 888.111; or (ii) A rent that does not exceed 30% of the adjusted income of a family whose annual income equals 65% of the median income for the area, as determined by HUD, with adjustments for number of bedrooms in the unit.

title: Newark HOME voucher-holder nondiscrimination
requirement: An owner of HOME-assisted units may not refuse to lease to a Section 8 certificate or voucher holder, or the holder of a comparable HOME tenant-based rental assistance document, because of that status.
coverage_conditions: HOME-assisted units in the City of Newark.

conditions.text: only HOME-assisted units receiving HOME Program funds are covered

coverage_quotes: The owner cannot refuse to lease HOME-assisted units to a certificate or voucher holder under 24 CFR part 982

quoted_span: The owner cannot refuse to lease HOME-assisted units to a certificate or voucher holder under 24 CFR part 982-Section 8 Tenant-Based Assistance
